name: Marching Caches
definition: An explicit data caching strategy for volume ray-casting that exploits inter-ray coherence by maintaining a shared cache around a bundle of rays, which is incrementally updated as the ray front advances through the volume, reducing global memory bandwidth.
summary: Marching Caches is an explicit data caching strategy for volume ray-casting that maintains a shared cache around a ray bundle to exploit inter-ray coherence and reduce global memory bandwidth.
